title: ADT reports third quarter 2026 financial results
summary: ADT's total revenue increased 4% to $1.3 billion in Q3 2026, and investments were made in AI, next-gen sensing technologies, and expanded retail distribution.
body_markdown:
###### Strong financial results and cash generation


###### Revenue up 4%; GAAP EPS up 18% and Adjusted EPS up 4%


###### Year-to-date GAAP Operating Cash Flows up 16%, Adjusted Free Cash Flow (including swaps) up 46%


###### Returned $748 million to shareholders year-to-date through share repurchases and dividends


ADT today reported results for the third quarter of 2026. Financial highlights for the third quarter are set forth below with variances on a year-over-year basis unless otherwise noted.


#### Third quarter 2026


- Total revenue increased 4% to $1.3 billion
- Solid core operating metrics with end-of-period recurring monthly revenue (RMR) of $360 million, gross revenue attrition of 13.1%, and revenue payback at 2.3 years
- GAAP income from continuing operations of $153 million, or $0.20 per diluted share, up $9 million
- Adjusted income from continuing operations of $176 million, or $0.24 per diluted share, down $11 million
- Net cash provided by operating activities of $440 million, down $40 million; Adjusted Free Cash Flow (including interest rate swaps) of $217 million, up $8 million


Jim DeVries, ADT Chairman, President and CEO


"ADT delivered solid third quarter results, with revenue growth, strong year-to-date cash generation and stable core operating metrics, reflecting the durability of our business and the dedication of our more than 12,000 employees," said Jim DeVries, ADT Chairman, President and CEO. “We are making meaningful progress in transforming ADT into a more intelligent and connected platform through investments in AI, next-generation sensing technologies, and expanded digital and retail distribution. As we look ahead to our next chapter, our focus remains on serving our customers and providing peace of mind."


---


#### Pending acquisition by Thrive Holdings


On Oct. 29, 2026, ADT announced that it has entered into a definitive agreement to be[acquired by Thrive Holdings](https://newsroom.adt.com/financial/adt-to-be-acquired-by-thrive-holdings-in-15-3-billion-transaction) in an all-cash transaction. Under the terms of the agreement, which ADT's Board of Directors unanimously approved, stockholders will receive $10.00 per share in cash upon completion. The transaction is expected to close in the first quarter of 2027, subject to customary closing conditions, including approval by stockholders and receipt of U.S. antitrust approval. Until the transaction closes, ADT will continue to operate independently as a public company. Following completion, ADT will become privately held, and its common stock will cease trading on the New York Stock Exchange. In consideration of the pending transaction, the company is not providing financial guidance and is withdrawing previously issued guidance.


---


#### Business highlights


###### Innovative Offerings, Unrivaled Safety and Premium Experience


ADT is undertaking focused initiatives to drive growth, strengthen brand loyalty, and improve customer acquisition efficiency while advancing its core mission of providing peace of mind. Recent progress on these initiatives is described below.


- **Expanding intelligent home innovation:** Introduced[Unusual Activity Alerts](https://newsroom.adt.com/smart-home/adt-expands-intelligent-home-features-with-unusual-activity-alerts) in ADT+, leveraging connected device and sensor data to identify meaningful changes in household activity and provide proactive customer notifications.


- **Progressing next-generation presence sensing:** Advanced[Origin AI-powered presence sensing](https://newsroom.adt.com/corporate-news/adt-acquires-origin-ai-to-power-ai-sensing-and-ambient-intelligence-for-the-home) capabilities, including ADT+ integration, development of future security and aging in place use cases, and commercialization planning for 2027 launch.


- **Scaling AI across customer experience:** Continued expanding AI-enabled sales and service capabilities including intelligent call routing, AI-driven inbound and outbound sales and service pilots, and more advanced transcription and agent assist capabilities to handle increasingly complex customer interactions.


- **Broadening customer choice and market reach:** Expanded[ADT Blu to Walmart.com](https://newsroom.adt.com/diy/adt-brings-adt-blu-to-walmart-com-expanding-availability-through-one-of-the-nations-largest-online-retailers) , increasing nationwide consumer access to ADT’s DIY security offering and broadening offerings across more customer segments and distribution channels.


- **Advancing ADT+ platform across channels:** Continued the phased rollout of ADT+ for dealer-generated new customer additions, extending the company’s technology platform and supporting a more consistent customer experience across channels.


- **Extending professional installation reach:** Launched ADT Partner Services, a new offering that brings ADT’s trusted brand, field expertise and national reach to more companies and customers. Through this offering, ADT will install and service select products for Apple Retail and its customers in the U.S. beginning this fall.


- **Strengthening community engagement impact and first responder partnerships:** Expanded ADT’s signature ADT Life Saver program with a community event in Houston and continued to support National Night Out celebrations across the country, reinforcing ADT’s commitment to safer communities.


###### Unlocking Shareholder Value


ADT remained focused on continuing to generate significant cash flow, enabling direct capital returns to shareholders while maintaining a healthy balance sheet.


- **Share repurchases:** During the third quarter, ADT repurchased and retired 3 million shares of its common stock for an aggregate price of $23 million. Year to date, the company has repurchased and retired 89 million shares of its common stock for an aggregate price of $617 million.


- **Enhancing financial flexibility:** In August, ADT secured $100 million of incremental borrowings under the First Lien Term Loan A due 2030, further strengthening the company’s financial flexibility.


- **Strategic bulk account purchase:** ADT completed a bulk purchase of approximately 8,000 customer accounts for $9 million cash.


---


#### Results of operations


Total revenue was $1,349 million for the third quarter, up 4%. The increase was primarily driven by higher security installation, product and other revenue due to an increase in the mix of professionally installed systems under the outright sales model. The decrease in Monitoring and related services (M&S) revenue reflects lower sales volume including the revenue loss from the October 2025 divestiture of the multifamily business, partially offset by higher average prices.


Income from continuing operations was $153 million, or $0.20 per diluted share, for the third quarter, up $9 million. This was driven by higher revenue, net of related costs, partially offset by higher selling, general, and administrative expenses, including the impact of the prior year goodwill impairment related to the divestiture of the multifamily business. Income from continuing operations also benefited from lower interest, including the impact of interest rate swaps.


Adjusted income from continuing operations was $176 million, or $0.24 per diluted share, for the third quarter, down $11 million, driven primarily by the same factors noted above excluding the prior year goodwill impairment and impact of interest rate swaps.


In addition to the factors above, earnings per share metrics benefited from a lower weighted-average diluted share count as a result of share repurchases. ****


---


#### Balance sheet and cash flow


For the third quarter, net cash provided by operating activities was $440 million, down $40 million, primarily reflecting higher net subscriber acquisition spend related to outright sales transactions, higher general and administrative expenses, and lower M&S margins, partially offset by lower cash taxes and favorable working capital timing. Adjusted Free Cash Flow (including interest rate swaps) was $217 million, up $8 million. This measure includes the same factors above excluding the subscriber acquisition impact from the transition to an outright sales model.


In August, the company secured $100 million of incremental borrowings under its First Lien Term Loan A due 2030, further enhancing financial flexibility and supporting general corporate purposes, which may include the repayment of a portion of the company’s 2027 notes.


Total cash and cash equivalents as of Sept. 30, 2026 were $228 million and no amounts were outstanding under the company’s First Lien Revolving Credit Facility.


ADT returned $64 million of capital to shareholders during the quarter, including $23 million of share repurchases and $41 million of dividend payments. Through the end of the third quarter, the company has repurchased 89 million shares returning $748 million to shareholders through share repurchases and dividends.


---


#### Conference call


As[previously announced](https://newsroom.adt.com/corporate-news/adt-to-release-third-quarter-2026-financial-results-on-nov-3) , management will host a conference call at 10 a.m. ET today to discuss the company’s third quarter 2026 results. In consideration of the proposed acquisition of ADT by Thrive Holdings announced on Oct. 29, 2026, the company will not be taking questions on the call. Participants may listen to a live webcast through the[Investor Relations website](https://investor.adt.com/) . Alternatively, participants may listen to the live call by dialing 1-833-461-5787 (toll-free) or 1-585-542-9983 and providing the access code 472959920. A replay of the webcast will be available on the website within 24 hours after the event.


A slide presentation highlighting the company’s results will also be available on the[Investor Relations website](https://investor.adt.com/) .
